title: Saskatoon Home Rebates 2026: Free Upgrades and Gas Equipment
desc: Saskatoon home rebates for 2026: SaskPower's free Energy Assistance Program is run with the City of Saskatoon, and SaskEnergy pays $325 to $1,000 for gas furnaces and water heaters. SaskPower's retrofit rebate has ended.
badge: Free upgrades and up to $1,000 for gas equipment
lead: Saskatoon is the one Saskatchewan city named in a rebate program: SaskPower's Energy Assistance Program is offered with the City of Saskatoon. It is free, and it is open to homeowners, renters and landlords. About 31% of Saskatoon homes were built since 2001, so the bigger rebate here is often for replacing gas equipment. Here is what is open on October 21, 2026.

sections:
The 2021 Census counted 107,050 households in the City of Saskatoon.

  • Newer homes. 32,670 homes (31%) were built from 2001 on, and 49,475 (46%) before 1981.
  • Owners and renters. 65% own and 35% rent.
  • Houses and apartments. 58,315 households (54%) live in single-detached houses and 25,635 in apartment buildings under five storeys.
  • Repairs. 4,480 homes (4%) needed major repairs.

The median household total income was $85,000 in 2020, before tax.
The free program that names Saskatoon

SaskPower's Energy Assistance Program installs LED light bulbs, low-flow faucet aerators, a drying rack, high-efficiency showerheads, a block heater timer, pipe wrap and a smart thermostat if you are eligible. SaskPower says it can save up to $230 a year. It is offered in partnership with the Government of Canada, the City of Saskatoon and the City of Swift Current Light and Power, and CLEAResult runs it. With 35% of Saskatoon households renting, it is worth knowing that renters and landlords can apply as well as homeowners. The steps are: apply online, schedule an appointment, have a home visit with an energy coach, and complete a short survey. The phone number is 306-910-7304.

SaskEnergy's Residential Equipment Replacement Rebate pays $325 for a furnace of 97.0% AFUE or better, $750 for a boiler of 95.0% AFUE or better, $800 for a combi boiler, and $1,000 for a tankless water heater (0.87 UEF) or a condensing water heater (0.80 UEF). The unit must run on natural gas, be on SaskEnergy's list, and replace part of your primary heating or water heating system. A gas contractor licensed through the Technical Safety Authority of Saskatchewan must install it, and you have 120 days to apply. Revised terms took effect August 17, 2026, and SaskEnergy may change or cancel the program at any time.
What ended, and what we did not find

SaskPower's Home Efficiency Retrofit Rebate ended in April 2026. We found no SaskPower or SaskEnergy rebate for heat pumps, insulation or windows. That is a negative result, not proof that none exists. Ottawa's National Heat Pump Rebate is expected in early 2027, and it may matter more in Saskatchewan than any provincial program. See our National Heat Pump Rebate guide.
claim_steps: Apply for the free Energy Assistance Program first.
If your furnace or water heater is out of warranty, price a high-efficiency gas replacement.
Check the unit is on SaskEnergy's eligible list before you buy.
Use a licensed gas contractor and apply within 120 days.
Sign up for our federal rebate alert.
faq: Is the Energy Assistance Program available in Saskatoon?
Yes. SaskPower offers it in partnership with the City of Saskatoon. It is free for homeowners, renters and landlords.
How much does SaskEnergy pay for a furnace in Saskatoon?
$325 for a furnace of at least 97.0% AFUE on SaskEnergy's list, installed by a licensed gas contractor.
Is there a heat pump rebate in Saskatoon?
We found no provincial heat pump rebate on SaskPower's or SaskEnergy's pages on October 21, 2026.
Does Saskatoon Light and Power matter for the rebates?
SaskPower's Energy Assistance Program names the City of Saskatoon as a partner. Check your electricity bill for your utility.
Can a Saskatoon landlord claim a rebate?
Yes. SaskEnergy's equipment rebate accepts landlords and rental companies that pay the invoice, and the Energy Assistance Program accepts landlords.
